title: Reproducibility Package: Catching Up Without Closing the Gap -- Convergence and Distribution Dynamics of Regional Dairy Productivity in Azerbaijan
description:
Complete reproducibility package for a study examining regional productivity convergence and persistence in Azerbaijan's dairy sector. Includes:

  • Python source code reproducing all convergence, distribution-dynamics, spatial-econometric, and extensive/intensive-margin analyses, tables, and figures for an unbalanced panel of 66 dairy-producing districts, 2000-2024;
  • The raw district-year production panel and the geoBoundaries administrative boundary data used to construct all spatial weight matrices;
  • Full documentation (codebook, data description with variable-level provenance, reproducibility checklist, and a step-by-step replication guide).

The study documents that robust panel beta-convergence in milk yield per cow coexists with rising cross-sectional dispersion (Quah's, 1993, Galton's Fallacy), shows via distribution-dynamics methods (kernel density estimation, Silverman's multimodality test, Markov transition matrices, Shorrocks' mobility index) that this reflects persistent immobility rather than convergence-club formation, uses global Moran's I and a spatial Markov chain to show this persistence is not primarily spatial, and relates it to heterogeneity in the extensive and intensive margins of production growth.

This package is organized around the study itself rather than any single journal submission, so that it remains valid regardless of the eventual publication venue or manuscript title.
